title: Utah County General Plan (current codified)
notes: THE CURRENT living General Plan for unincorporated Utah County. Revised and adopted IN ITS ENTIRETY 2020-12-30 by Ordinance 2020-1110 (effective 2021-02-05), re-numbered/re-formatted for Municode, and continuously amended since — most recent amendment Ord. 2025-1064 (Water Use & Preservation Element) 2025-12-31. Chapters: 1 Preface/Introduction; 2 Goals, Objectives & Policies (16 objectives); 4 MODERATE INCOME HOUSING ELEMENT (MIH lives inside the GP, no standalone plan); 6 Transportation & Traffic Circulation; 8 Environmental; 9 Resource/Water/Agriculture; 10 Land Use Element. Codified web book (not a stored PDF) — text extracted from the municipalcodeonline print view. Supersedes the 2006 PDF below.
